title: OpenAI and Broadcom announce strategic collaboration to deploy 10 gigawatts of OpenAI-designed AI accelerators
summary: OpenAI and Broadcom announce a multi-year partnership to deploy 10 gigawatts of OpenAI-designed AI accelerators, co-developing next-generation systems and Ethernet solutions to power scalable, energy-efficient AI infrastructure by 2029.
body: OpenAI and Broadcom announce a multi-year partnership to deploy 10 gigawatts of OpenAI-designed AI accelerators, co-developing next-generation systems and Ethernet solutions to power scalable, energy-efficient AI infrastructure by 2029.
summaryZh: OpenAI与博通（Broadcom）宣布达成多年期战略合作，计划部署总计10吉瓦由OpenAI自行设计的AI加速器。双方将共同开发下一代系统与以太网解决方案，以支持到2029年规模化、高能效的AI底层基础设施建设。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI与博通宣布战略合作，计划部署10吉瓦自主设计的AI加速器芯片。
aiReview.summaryZh: OpenAI与博通（Broadcom）宣布达成多年期战略合作，计划部署总计10吉瓦由OpenAI自行设计的AI加速器。双方将共同开发下一代系统与以太网解决方案，以支持到2029年规模化、高能效的AI底层基础设施建设。

glossary.explanationZh: 全球领先的半导体和基础设施软件解决方案公司
专门用于加速人工智能和机器学习算法计算的硬件芯片
以太网网络连接解决方案，用于连接大规模算力集群
吉瓦（十亿瓦特），通常用于衡量大型AI数据中心的总电力消耗
